item.title: Semaglutide for weight control more common among women using hormonal contraception
item.description: A nested case-control study found that women using hormonal contraception were more likely to start semaglutide for weight management.

item.title: Oral GLP-1 Reduces Weight and A1c in Older Adults With Obesity
item.description: Once-daily oral orforglipron is an effective weight-loss option for adults 65 and older with overweight or obesity, regardless of type 2 diabetes status.

item.title: Children's Language Use May Predict Future Mental Health Issues
item.description: Linguistic analysis of children's words about stressful events predicted future mental health problems better than other methods.

item.title: When Health 'Optimization' Becomes Unhealthy
item.description: Doctors report some patients take health optimization to extremes, and they are addressing the issue.
